claim: Dengue is the most common arboviral infection worldwide and is found mainly in tropical and subtropical areas.
source: Dengue is the most common arboviral infection worldwide and is found mainly in tropical and subtropical areas.
evidence: This is supported by established scientific consensus about dengue epidemiology.
